name: AppleTaggers
summary:
Apple Taggers VR is an action-packed multiplayer VR experience built around fast movement, smooth locomotion, and chaotic fun.

Become an Apple and enter vibrant arenas where players climb, jump, and sprint using full VR motion. One player starts as the tagger, and the rest must escape using skillful movement, parkour routes, and quick reactions. Get tagged — and the chase continues.
